name: Strange Phone
source:
A game about a young guy who gets a job at a big company. He is given a service phone on which he finds an unusual application. He can spy on other people. And his life begins to change dramatically.

[From [url=https://tfgames.site/index.php?module=viewgame&id=3278]TF Games Site[/url]]
